name: Gluetun-Full
description: Gluetun - Lightweight swiss-army-knife-like VPN client to multiple VPN service providers. VPN client in a thin Docker container for multiple VPN providers, written in Go, and using OpenVPN or Wireguard, DNS over TLS, with a few proxy servers built-in. 'Gluetun-Full' is an attempt to: include ALL of the published paths, ports, & variables available for Gluetun (set to their defaults) from the upstream project, repo, & wiki; to keep them ALL up-to-date as much as possible; and to include Gluetun-Wiki URLs for each config item; all presented in a useful template for the Unraid community.
